_comment: Merge-base ratchet policy (DATA, not code — ADR-0551, fixes FRIC-1781112000; ADR-0616 regenerate-from-merge-base-source). The firewall's frozen reference is the gate-baseline face at `git merge-base <base_ref> HEAD`, NEVER the PR-local working-tree copy. ADR-0616: `frozen_reference.source` is `regenerate-from-merge-base-source`, so the scm-facts emitter (the single sanctioned out-of-graph git boundary, ADR-0515 D3) REGENERATES `face_path` by running the accounting producer over the merge-base SOURCE worktree — it is NO LONGER read from a committed git blob, and `face_path` is DE-COMMITTED (not-tracked-in-git). The emitter validates the regeneration with a determinism canary and binds it to the merge-base tree via provenance, then writes the provenance-wrapped snapshot to `out_path` (untracked + gitignored; CI rematerializes it before gates consume it). `base_ref` is the configurable comparison root: adopters repoint it to their integration branch. Precedent: Bazel affected-target-set computes the base from base-revision source and never commits it; Google Tricorder/Critique recompute analysis from source at the base revision; SLSA/in-toto trust derived artifacts via signed build provenance.

_provenance.authority: ADR-0551 merge-base frozen baseline ratchet; FRIC-1781112000; ADR-0616 regenerate-from-merge-base-source
